newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-AT&T lowered to hold from buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-AT&T lowered to hold from buy.

text.p: -- Hilliard Lyons said its telecommunications analyst David Burks lowered his rating on AT&T Corp to a hold from a buy following AT&T's announcement that third quarter earnings could be as much as 10 percent lower than analysts estimates.
-- AT&T also said its fourth quarter results are likely to fall short of analysts' estimates.
-- Burks, a telecommunications industry analyst, said this is Hilliard Lyons' first downgrade of AT&T in 2-1/2 years.

-- The downgrade follows disappointing second quarter results. Burks said the primary reason for ongoing sluggish results is the intense competition in the consumer long distance business. He sees little chance that this environment will ease soon and said he believes a more cautious approach towards the stock is appropriate.
-- AT&T shares are trading unchanged at 51-5/8.
